feed_title: Upholstered Orthopaedic Dog Sofa Bed, Memory Foam Base, Raised Back and Arms, Medium to Extra Large, 4 Colours, Washable Cover | PawLunova Windsor
descriptionHtml:
Memory foam inside. Upholstery and piped seams outside.

Windsor is an upholstered orthopaedic dog sofa with a memory foam base and a washable cover, in Medium, Large and Extra Large, in Blue, Green, Brown or Grey.

Two things pull against each other in a living room. The bed with real foam in it is a slab you hide behind a chair. The one that suits the room is thin, and by nine the dog is on your settee.

This puts the memory foam inside upholstery fabric with piped seams, so the thing beside your sofa reads as furniture.

What they get

  • A memory foam base: Foam rather than loose filling that shifts out from under.
  • A back and two arms: Raised on three sides for a chin or a full sideways lean.
  • Upholstery fabric with piped seams: Four colourways: Blue, Green, Brown and Grey.
  • A cover that comes off: Removable and machine washable, following the sewn-in care label.

Best for: rooms where the bed has to look like it belongs, and dogs who would otherwise take your settee.

Why it is worth the money

Compare it against the thing it replaces, which is your sofa. The Medium is £99, the Large £129 and the Extra Large £149. Five years of no-flatten guarantee on the foam core is 1825 nights, so the Medium comes to about 5p a night and the Extra Large about 8p. You are not gambling it on a hunch either. Inside 100 nights the collection is free from the UK mainland and the refund is full.

One thing we cannot do for you. The measurements of the three sizes are not published, so do not order on the name alone. The back and arms take up part of the footprint, so between two sizes take the larger.

Size and fit

Three sizes: Medium, Large and Extra Large. Four colours: Blue, Green, Brown and Grey. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Then message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Take the cover off and machine wash it, following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

Which size do I order?

Send us their breed and weight. Sizes are not published as measurements.

Is delivery included?

On orders over £40 it is. Timings show at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

Does it really look like furniture?

Upholstery fabric and piped seams in four colours, with a raised back.

Is it suitable for an older dog?

A memory foam base with a back and arms. Your vet knows their legs.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover comes off and goes in the machine at the label temperature.

What if they prefer our sofa?

Then it goes back within 100 nights, collected free and refunded.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Pick a colour and give them a seat of their own.
